operatorControl: team-controlled child processes with distinct signing keys and payout identities; primary uses the fixture key
outage: worker-crash kills the primary process after its checkpoint; primary-provider-outage additionally prevents either primary-host specialist from bidding
design: Paired live-inference repairs, pinned held-out acceptance and independent audit tests. HTTP coordinator, persisted events, real worker processes, fixture vault transfers. Fixed specialists and Backstop use the same roster, caps, timing and standby commitments on every pair.

trials.deliveredSource: function spans({samples,high,low}){let s=-1;let run=0;const out=[];for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i++){if(s<0){if(samples[i]>=high){s=i;run=0;}}else{if(samples[i]<=low){run++;if(run===2){out.push([s,i-1]);s=-1;run=0;}}else{run=0;}}}if(s>=0)out.push([s,samples.length]);return out;}
